title: Practice: plan a session, say what changed, and set the options (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the plan resumes an unchanged session and tells a changed one what differs and starts fresh when most of it changed
cases.says: An untouched session resumes, a changed one resumes with a notice, a mostly changed one starts fresh

cases.id: e1 changed deleted and added files are listed in order and any difference asks for a notice
cases.says: Changed, deleted and added files are listed in order, and any difference asks for a notice

cases.id: e2 more than half of the files changed or gone starts fresh and exactly half does not
cases.says: More than half changed or gone starts fresh, exactly half does not, and new files do not count toward it

cases.id: e3 a session idle for more than a week starts fresh and exactly a week is resumed
cases.says: More than a week idle starts fresh, exactly a week does not

cases.id: e4 no saved session starts fresh and a fork is only planned from a session that is resumed
cases.says: No record starts fresh, and a fork is planned only from a resumed session

cases.id: e5 the change notice names only what differs and the prompt puts the notice or the summary before the task
cases.says: The notice names only what differs, and the prompt puts the notice or the summary before the task

cases.id: e6 the summary has a fixed layout with blank and repeated items dropped and files listed by path
cases.says: The summary has the fixed layout, with blanks and repeats dropped and files sorted by path

cases.id: e7 options resume by id and fork together and continue is refused unless one session exists and a name must be unique
cases.says: Resume and fork go together, continue needs exactly one session, a name must be unique

cases.id: e8 a run through the sdk passes resume and fork to the binary and returns the session id even after an error
cases.says: A run through the SDK sends --resume and --fork-session and returns the session id, also after an error
